description: This is a Python script for a spelling linter adapter that uses codespell to check for spelling errors in files, with functions for running codespell, checking file size, and validating a dictionary file.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enum class defining severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: NamedTuple class representing a lint message with details about the issue.

methods.name: format_error_message
methods.description: Creates a LintMessage object for errors encountered during linting.

methods.name: run_codespell
methods.description: Executes the codespell library as a subprocess to check spelling in a file.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Checks a file for spelling errors and size constraints, returns lint messages.

methods.name: check_dictionary
methods.description: Validates the dictionary file for duplicates and sorting, returns lint messages.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and run lint checks concurrently.
